tableLookup.title: Auto Table Existence Check (T3SMARTSCM.dbo)
tableLookup.explain: Looks up TB_* table names in your prompt directly against the backend DB — if it exists, Entity is mapped to existing columns; otherwise a new SQL_DDL artifact is generated. The result is auto-attached to the Claude prompt context.

tableLookup.notExists: Does not exist — a new SQL_DDL artifact will be generated (allowed in NEW_NL mode)

items.text: Build a user list view/save/delete screen using the TB_AD_USER table and SP_UI_AD_01_Q1 / _S1 / _D1 procedures.
Item master CRUD screen on the existing TB_CM_ITEM_MST table. Generate read/save/delete SPs as needed.
Inventory status screen querying the VW_INVENTORY_PLAN_CONFIRMED view — search by location and item, results in a grid.
Design a new table for notices and build screens to create/edit/delete notices.
Pick a mockup via [Select SCM UI Mockup] above and Claude will reference its layout skeleton. Just describe the data requirements in the prompt. (Exclusive with UI Pattern.)
Pick a T3MES pattern via [Select UI Pattern] above and Claude will reference its markup. (Exclusive with SCM UI Mockup.)
Drop up to 5 SQL files / design images / captures into the [Reference file attach] area below to include them as references. Can be combined with Mockup / UI Pattern selection.
